title: Agent Skill frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of an Agent Skill's SKILL.md: a name and a description, and whatever else the skill carries.
$comment: The limits on name and description are the Agent Skills specification's limits as recorded in checkride's design. One of that specification's rules can't be written as JSON Schema, that name equals the parent directory's name: checkride's schema slot checks it beside this schema, and reports it under the keyword directory-name.

name.description: The skill's name: lowercase letters and digits in hyphen-separated words, at most 64 characters, and the name of the directory that holds its SKILL.md.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it, in 1 to 1024 characters.
